verdict.rationale: Sakana Marlin's docs consistently describe autonomous, multi-step research: forming hypotheses, gathering information, resolving contradictions, running thousands of automated cycles over up to eight hours to produce a full report, without further human input after initial framing. Testimonials corroborate depth beyond single-pass summarization (review-paper level depth, primary-source grounding). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification beyond vendor testimonials, and technical detail on how multi-step reasoning/investigation is architected.
